svg.title: Scribe
svg.desc: Scribe's ring + shield mark -- the same simplified brand mark used elsewhere in the app for small/loading contexts (see AjoLoader), sized for legibility as a browser tab icon. The full multi-element logo (ring, people, documents, shield, naira badge) is used in the navbar and app icons, where there's enough resolution for it to read clearly; it does not read at 16x16.
